title: GET /api/metering/usage counts free_in_context events as chargeable: totals.count and usdTotal use amount > 0, and the price is applied at read time
description:
**Read from code at develop** `e43a289c1c7b`**, not run against a stack.** Found while checking `METERING-USAGE-API.md` for KS-1807 PR-4 and re-read by me.

**What the code does.** `getUsageSummary` in `services/originate/src/services/chargeEvents.ts` computes `chargeable_count` as `SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)` and multiplies that by the event type's USD price, read live from the pricing config at request time. It does not look at `fee_status`. `createChargeEvent` stores the event type's price as `amount` even when the caller passes `feeStatus: 'free_in_context'`. The verification-certificate path (`services/originate/src/routes/certifications.ts`, around line 1451, "free_in_context for recruitment") records exactly such an event.

**Effect.** Events recorded as `free_in_context` are counted in `totals.count` and in `usdTotal` as if they were chargeable. This is the figure Platform S reads to reconcile K usage against subscriptions (the page says "there is no per-event client billing", so the effect is on reconciliation rather than on a charge). Separately, because the price is applied at read time, the same window read on two days gets two different `usdTotal` values if the price changed in between.

**Not established.** Whether any real tenant has `free_in_context` rows (not measured); whether Platform S subtracts them on its side (not in this tree); the intended definition of "chargeable" (the docs say free usage is not billed, but no ruling was found for this event type).

**Docs.** `METERING-USAGE-API.md` now states what the code does, as a known deviation, in KS-1807 PR-4.
